items.question: Where did Alana Beard play college basketball?
items.answer: Alana Beard played at Duke and graduated as the school's all-time leading scorer with 2,687 points. The Washington Mystics drafted her second overall in 2004.

items.question: What were Alana Beard's career averages?
items.answer: Alana Beard averaged 11.3 points, 3.4 rebounds and 2.5 assists in 420 WNBA regular-season games from 2004 to 2019. Her best scoring season was 2006, at 19.2 points per game for Washington.

items.question: Is Alana Beard in the Hall of Fame?
items.answer: Yes. Alana Beard was inducted into the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame with the Class of 2025.

items.question: Was Alana Beard a good defender?

items.question: How old is Alana Beard?

items.question: Where did Alana Beard go to high school?
